verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions an app marketplace or a catalog of thousands of third-party integrations. What it does show is a REST API with OAuth, MCP support for AI agents, calendar subscription, and embedding cloud files from Figma, Google Docs, and Dropbox. These are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a marketplace a product manager can use to connect tools.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can connect my workspace to thousands of third-party tools via an app marketplace
